facts.description: Base class for all SPARQL-VI queries. ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Every query MUST start with a query type keyword: CHONJ_KW (SELECT), XAY_DUNGWJ (CONSTRUCT), HOIQQ_YZ (ASK), or MO_TAR_PP (DESCRIBE). Modifiers like SAP_XXEP_THEO_KK, GIOI_HHAN_RR come AFTER the main query structure.

CHONJ_KW query returns variable bindings. Equivalent to SPARQL SELECT. ⚠️ COMPLETE STRUCTURE: CHONJ_KW ?variable NOII_MA_KK { pattern } [modifiers]. The NOII_MA_KK (WHERE) clause is REQUIRED. Optional modifiers: SAP_XXEP_THEO_KK, GIOI_HHAN_RR, etc.
XAY_DUNGWJ query returns RDF graph. Equivalent to SPARQL CONSTRUCT. ⚠️ COMPLETE STRUCTURE: XAY_DUNGWJ { template } NOII_MA_KK { pattern } [modifiers].

HOIQQ_YZ query returns boolean (true/false). Equivalent to SPARQL ASK. ⚠️ COMPLETE STRUCTURE: HOIQQ_YZ NOII_MA_KK { pattern }. No SELECT variables needed. Returns true if pattern matches, false otherwise.
MO_TAR_PP query returns RDF description of resource. Equivalent to SPARQL DESCRIBE. ⚠️ COMPLETE STRUCTURE: MO_TAR_PP ?resource NOII_MA_KK { pattern } [modifiers].
Base class for all clauses
NOII_MA_KK clause contains graph patterns. Required for most queries.
LOCJ_RR filters solutions by condition. Equivalent to SPARQL FILTER.
facts.constraint: Must be used inside NOII_MA_KK clause
